values: Visitor verifies email and receives an active Customer account
Dependencies: TECH-02, SMTP proof. Acceptance: valid/expired/reused/replaced token; ACTIVE login only. Backlog outcome: Verified Customer registration.
Active user receives a secure role-appropriate session
Dependencies: TECH-02, Manager seed. Acceptance: session rotation, state rejection, CSRF refresh, role navigation. Backlog outcome: Role-correct login session.
Current session ends and protected APIs reject it
Dependencies: UC-02. Acceptance: POST+CSRF invalidates session; protected API becomes 401. Backlog outcome: Session logout.
Customer views and updates own allowed contact fields
Dependencies: UC-02. Acceptance: field validation and server-owned Customer identity isolation. Backlog outcome: Own Customer profile maintenance.
Customer creates, edits, selects default, and deactivates own addresses
Dependencies: UC-02. Acceptance: create/edit/default/deactivate; wrong-owner request is rejected. Backlog outcome: Own delivery-address maintenance.
User replaces password after proving the current password
Dependencies: UC-02. Acceptance: wrong current password rejected; all existing sessions invalidated. Backlog outcome: Own password replacement.
Account owner uses a one-use expiring email token to replace password
Dependencies: SMTP proof. Acceptance: generic response; 30-minute, replacement, reuse, session tests. Backlog outcome: Forgotten-password recovery.
Manager creates/edits/activates/deactivates Staff and issues setup access
Dependencies: UC-02, SMTP proof. Acceptance: Staff-only target guard; setup/activate/deactivate/session behavior. Backlog outcome: Staff account lifecycle.
Visitor receives a paged active catalogue matching filters/sort/search
Dependencies: UC-19–20 seed. Acceptance: active filtering, bounded stable paging, search/sort, no N+1 evidence. Backlog outcome: Public catalogue/search.
Visitor sees one active product, purchasable SKUs, price, and availability
Dependencies: UC-20. Acceptance: active visibility, availability, inactive/missing behavior. Backlog outcome: Public Product/SKU detail.
Visitor adds, changes, removes, or clears browser-local SKU quantities
Dependencies: UC-09–10. Acceptance: add/update/remove/clear; corrupt/stale storage; server values untrusted. Backlog outcome: Browser-local cart.
Server revalidates address/price/stock/payment, reserves stock, snapshots sale, and creates one order
Dependencies: UC-05, UC-11, UC-20–21. Acceptance: rollback, stale price, last-unit race, exact retry/conflicting key. Backlog outcome: Atomic Customer order placement.
One verified gateway result records collection once and confirms the pending order
Dependencies: UC-12, provider proof. Acceptance: bad signature/ref/amount, duplicate, expiry and late-success race. Backlog outcome: Verified idempotent online payment.
Customer sees only own orders with paging and filters
Dependencies: UC-12. Acceptance: mandatory owner predicate, status filter, deterministic paging. Backlog outcome: Owned paged order history.
View Own Order Detail and Receipt
Customer sees owned order/payment/timeline/return state and paid receipt when eligible
Dependencies: UC-12–14. Acceptance: no cross-owner leakage; payment/return/actions and paid-only receipt. Backlog outcome: Owned order detail/timeline/receipt.
Eligible pending/confirmed order is cancelled, reservation released, and paid value becomes refund due
Dependencies: UC-12–13. Acceptance: allowed/forbidden states, release movement, paid/late refund-due state. Backlog outcome: Eligible Customer cancellation.
Operator searches all channels and lifecycle states by business criteria
Dependencies: UC-12, UC-29 fixtures. Acceptance: role guard, channel/status/date filters, actionable preset, bounded stable paging. Backlog outcome: Staff/Manager sales-order search.
Operator sees operational, stock, payment, return, receipt, audit, and allowed actions
Dependencies: UC-17, ledgers. Acceptance: projection without duplication; Staff/Manager action differences. Backlog outcome: Operational order detail/actions.
Manager maintains Category and Brand reference data in one workspace
Dependencies: UC-02 Manager. Acceptance: normalized uniqueness; referenced-active deactivation conflict. Backlog outcome: Category/Brand workspace.
Manager maintains product content and manually defined sale units/SKUs with price, threshold, and active state
Dependencies: UC-19. Acceptance: activation invariants, immutable SKU code/history, stale version conflict. Backlog outcome: Product/SKU workspace.
Operator searches on-hand, reserved, available, and low-stock SKU balances
Dependencies: UC-20. Acceptance: on-hand/reserved/available, low-stock, inactive-stock discoverability. Backlog outcome: Current inventory overview.
Operator records one external delivery and atomically increases its SKU balances
Dependencies: UC-20–21. Acceptance: multi-line balance/movement tie-out, rollback, retry/fingerprint conflict. Backlog outcome: Atomic stock receipt.
Manager records a reasoned non-zero correction without violating reservations
Dependencies: UC-21. Acceptance: Manager/reason/version/nonnegative/reservation guards and one movement. Backlog outcome: Guarded stock adjustment.
Manager inspects immutable physical/reservation movements by SKU/order/reference
Dependencies: all stock-changing UCs. Acceptance: filters, stable paging, business-reference trace, no edit/delete. Backlog outcome: Immutable movement history.
Eligible confirmed order becomes packing with actor/time history
Dependencies: UC-17–18. Acceptance: guarded single transition/history; zero stock delta. Backlog outcome: Confirmed order packing.
Eligible packed order leaves stock and becomes shipping
Dependencies: UC-25. Acceptance: order-then-SKU lock, exact physical/reserve deltas, duplicate guard. Backlog outcome: Packed order dispatch.
Shipping order becomes completed after success or terminal delivery-failed after returned failure
Dependencies: UC-26. Acceptance: exact COD collection or restored stock; terminal duplicate/race tests. Backlog outcome: Delivery success/returned failure.
Manager cancels an allowed pre-shipping order with reason, stock release, and refund-due result
Dependencies: UC-18, payment/stock ledgers. Acceptance: reason/state/role guards, reservation release, refund-due projection. Backlog outcome: Manager pre-shipping cancellation.
One atomic command creates a completed cash sale, collection, stock movements, and receipt
Dependencies: UC-20–21, ledgers. Acceptance: last-unit race, retry, full rollback, cash/stock/order reconciliation. Backlog outcome: Atomic cash counter sale.
Customer creates the one allowed item/quantity request for an eligible owned DELIVERY order
Dependencies: UC-15, completed DELIVERY order. Acceptance: owner/deadline/reason/line caps, one request, retry conflict. Backlog outcome: Owned Customer return request.
Operator creates the one allowed item/quantity request after validating receipt/order evidence
Dependencies: UC-18/29, completed order. Acceptance: receipt evidence, either sale channel, line caps, duplicate guard. Backlog outcome: Receipt-based in-store request.
Manager approves the complete eligible request or rejects it with reason
Dependencies: UC-30–31. Acceptance: Manager-only approve-all/reject, reason, stale/duplicate behavior. Backlog outcome: Whole-request Manager decision.
Operator performs one intake, records disposition quantities, and restores sellable stock
Dependencies: UC-32. Acceptance: positive receipt, disposition equation, sellable movement, no second intake. Backlog outcome: One physical return intake.
Manager records actual eligible money returned for a cancellation/failure/received return without exceeding cap
Dependencies: UC-16/27/33, money ledger. Acceptance: source eligibility, exact remaining cap, duplicate and atomic state tests. Backlog outcome: Actual capped refund completion.
Manager sees collections, refunds, and net cash movement by transaction date/method
Dependencies: complete money ledger. Acceptance: half-open transaction dates; collection-refund-net independent tie-out. Backlog outcome: Cash movement report.
Manager sees completed sales volume/value/channel/product demand by completion date
Dependencies: completed order snapshots. Acceptance: completion cohort, channels/payment dimensions, item sum tie-out. Backlog outcome: Gross completed-sales report.
Manager sees opening balances plus period deltas reconciling to closing balances
Dependencies: complete movement ledger. Acceptance: opening + categorized deltas = closing, boundary and seed tests. Backlog outcome: Inventory roll-forward report.
